abstract: Access to clean cooking fuels is central to advancing health, equity, and environmental sustainability worldwide. However, despite sustained policy efforts, a substantial share of households, especially in developing countries, still rely on polluting fuels, with adverse effects on health, environmental quality, and economic well-being. This paper draws on a panel dataset of 102 developing countries spanning 2000–2022 to assess the relationship between access to clean cooking fuels and human well-being. Using fixed-effects and instrumental-variable estimators, we address potential endogeneity concerns. We further explore heterogeneity across rural and urban settings and show that improvements in access are associated with larger gains in health and nutrition outcomes in urban areas. Focusing on sub-Saharan Africa, we conduct scenario-based simulations to quantify the potential benefits of expanding access to clean cooking fuels. Increasing rural access from 10% to 25% is estimated to prevent around 84,000 infant deaths and reduce child stunting by approximately 1.68 million cases. In urban areas, achieving universal access from a baseline of 35% coverage could avert up to 377,000 infant deaths and generate more than 11 million disability-adjusted life years saved, reflecting a substantial reduction in disease burden linked to household air pollution. These results point to the need to accelerate progress toward universal access to clean cooking fuels through targeted, context-specific policies. While rural populations remain underserved and require continued attention, the magnitude of potential gains in urban areas underscores the case for a balanced strategy in clean energy policy design.
abstract_zh: 获得清洁烹饪燃料是促进全球健康、公平和环境可持续性的核心。然而，尽管政策持续努力，仍有相当比例的家庭，尤其是发展中国家家庭，依赖污染性燃料，对健康、环境质量和经济福祉造成不利影响。本文利用涵盖2000—2022年102个发展中国家的小组数据集，评估清洁烹饪燃料可及性与人类福祉之间的关系。我们使用固定效应和工具变量估计量来处理潜在的内生性问题。我们进一步探讨农村与城市环境中的异质性，并表明可及性的改善与城市地区健康和营养结果的更大收益相关。聚焦撒哈拉以南非洲，我们开展情景模拟，以量化扩大清洁烹饪燃料可及性的潜在收益。将农村可及性从10%提高到25%，估计可避免约84,000例婴儿死亡，并减少约168万例儿童发育迟缓。在城市地区，从35%覆盖率的基线实现全民可及，可避免多达377,000例婴儿死亡，并产生超过1,100万伤残调整生命年得以挽救，反映出与家庭空气污染相关的疾病负担大幅降低。这些结果表明，需要通过有针对性的、符合具体情境的政策，加快实现清洁烹饪燃料全民可及的进展。虽然农村人口仍服务不足并需要持续关注，但城市地区潜在收益的规模凸显了在清洁能源政策设计中采取平衡战略的理由。
title: Health and nutrition returns to clean cooking fuel access across the rural-urban divide
title_zh: 清洁烹饪燃料获取对城乡健康与营养的回报

abstract: This study addresses a longstanding question in resource economics: whether largescale gold mining generates enclave-type production structures or promotes broader production linkages through changes in firm behavior and factor allocation. Using geocoded panel data on African manufacturing and service enterprises, we document that firms near active gold mines, relative to those near inactive mining sites, experience restructuring of local production systems, reflected in higher sales, employment, and labor productivity alongside reduced reliance on imported inputs. We identify labor upgrading and domestic supply-chain deepening as key mechanisms. Firms near active mines rely less on temporary and female workers while employing more skilled workers at higher wages, supplier-intensive industries show stronger responses alongside lower material input costs, and firms face fewer infrastructure and administrative constraints. These spillovers are stronger in better-governed countries, service sectors, and foreign-affiliated firms, highlighting the conditions under which resource extraction may support structural transformation rather than enclave-type growth.
title: Golden opportunities: Mining, production linkages, and firm development
title_zh: 黄金机遇：矿业、生产关联与企业发展的关系

abstract: This paper quantifies the role of bank lending in shaping the short-run effects of climate policy on the economy. Using carbon price surprises from the EU Emissions Trading System we document that higher carbon prices, while successfully reducing emissions, lead to lower economic activity, lower bank capital and higher credit spreads. We further show that banks with greater exposure to emission-intensive industries reduce credit supply more strongly in response to an increase in carbon price. We interpret these empirical facts through the lens of a dynamic stochastic general equilibrium model with polluting and non-polluting sectors, nominal price rigidities, and a bank credit channel. The model matches well the empirical impulse responses of key aggregates to a carbon policy shock. Counterfactual simulations suggest that the bank credit channel plays a quantitatively meaningful role in the transmission of carbon policy shocks. Finally, implications for the design of macroprudential and monetary policies are explored.
abstract_zh: 本文量化了银行信贷在塑造气候政策对经济短期影响中的作用。利用欧盟排放交易体系的碳价意外变动，我们记录到，碳价上升虽成功减少了排放，却导致经济活动下降、银行资本减少及信用利差扩大。进一步研究表明，对高排放行业敞口较大的银行，在碳价上升时信贷供给缩减更为显著。我们通过一个包含污染与非污染部门、名义价格刚性及银行信贷渠道的动态随机一般均衡模型来解释这些实证事实。该模型很好地匹配了碳政策冲击下关键总量指标的实证脉冲响应。反事实模拟表明，银行信贷渠道在碳政策冲击传导中发挥着数量上显著的作用。最后，本文探讨了其对宏观审慎及货币政策设计的启示。
journal: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
source_issue: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
title: Macroeconomic Effects of Carbon Pricing: The Role of Bank Credit
title_zh: 碳定价的宏观经济效应：银行信贷的作用

abstract: This paper examines how poor in utero conditions caused by severe typhoons affect psychological well-being later in life. We exploit variation in the timing and location of severe typhoon landfalls. Our design compares individuals with higher expected fetal exposure in landfall counties to those with no such exposure. A one-unit increase in expected in utero exposure raises the likelihood of an adult mental illness diagnosis by 2.2 percentage points, or 11 percent relative to the mean. The incidence of mood disorders such as depression and the use of antidepressants has risen by more than 50 percent. The adverse effects are concentrated among women. In a fully interacted model, we reject equality of the male and female effects for our main outcomes. This gender gap is not driven by differential healthcare-seeking behavior. We discuss several non-mutually exclusive mechanisms that could generate a genuinely female-concentrated effect, including sex-specific fetal programming and mortality selection
abstract_zh: 本文考察了由严重台风导致的恶劣宫内环境如何影响个体成年后的心理健康状况。我们利用严重台风登陆时间与地点的变异，将预期胎儿期暴露程度较高的登陆县个体与无此类暴露的个体进行比较。预期宫内暴露每增加一个单位，成年期精神疾病诊断的可能性提高2.2个百分点，相对于均值而言增加11%。情绪障碍（如抑郁症）的发病率及抗抑郁药物的使用量上升超过50%。不利影响主要集中在女性群体中。在完全交互模型中，我们拒绝了主要结局指标中男性和女性效应相等的假设。这一性别差异并非由就医行为的差异所驱动。我们讨论了若干非互斥的机制，这些机制可能产生真正集中于女性的效应，包括性别特异性胎儿编程和死亡选择。
title: The long shadow of typhoons: Prenatal exposure and adult mental health
title_zh: 台风的长影：产前暴露与成年心理健康

abstract: The accelerated development of solar photovoltaic (PV) is crucial for achieving global climate goals, yet it poses significant ecological challenges due to the extensive land occupation. The “PV + ” land use model could be a countermeasure. By quantifying the ecological cost of multiple PV expansion scenarios in China and the potential ecological compensation capacity of “PV + ” model, we present an optimized energy expansion pathway. From the perspective of ecosystem services, we found that historical PV expansion caused an ecological loss of $2.15 billion (0.78 USD/m2). Without energy pathway optimization, the accelerated expansion required to meet 2050 targets would lead to ecological losses of $18.56 to $37.11 billion. However, pathway optimization can reduce those losses by 58–81%. Our analysis based on field investigations revealed that the "PV + " system holds significant potential for ecological compensation. Agriculture–PV has the highest capacity (0.63 USD/m2), even exceeding the pre-construction value of cropland, while Grassland–PV and Gobi and Desert-PV also achieve ecological restoration. Prioritizing the development of suitable land or barren land is the optimal expansion path to achieve a triple-win situation in energy, economics, and ecology. The power generation capacity of these pathways could reach 7.21–19.75 PWh annually by 2050, while reducing ecological costs to 0.09–0.19 USD/m2. This study provides guidance for ecologically considerate PV expansion planning and supports the sustainable management of PV power plants, offering a replicable solution for optimizing global renewable energy expansion.
abstract_zh: 太阳能光伏（PV）的加速发展对于实现全球气候目标至关重要，然而由于大量土地占用，它也带来了显著的生态挑战。“光伏+”土地利用模式或可成为应对之策。通过量化中国多种光伏扩张情景下的生态成本及“光伏+”模式的潜在生态补偿能力，我们提出了一条优化的能源扩张路径。从生态系统服务的角度来看，我们发现历史光伏扩张已造成21.5亿美元（0.78美元/平方米）的生态损失。若不对能源路径进行优化，为满足2050年目标所需的加速扩张将导致185.6亿至371.1亿美元的生态损失。然而，路径优化可将这些损失减少58%至81%。基于实地调查的分析表明，“光伏+”系统具有显著的生态补偿潜力。农业-光伏模式的补偿能力最高（0.63美元/平方米），甚至超过了农田建设前的价值，而草地-光伏和戈壁沙漠-光伏模式同样实现了生态修复。优先开发适宜土地或荒芜土地是实现能源、经济和生态三方共赢的最优扩张路径。到2050年，这些路径的发电能力可达每年7.21至19.75拍瓦时，同时将生态成本降至0.09至0.19美元/平方米。本研究为兼顾生态考量的光伏扩张规划提供了指导，并支持光伏电站的可持续管理，为优化全球可再生能源扩张提供了可复制的解决方案。

title: Ecological impacts and countermeasures for future solar photovoltaic expansion: Based on the assessment and planning of ecosystem services
title_zh: 未来太阳能光伏扩张的生态影响与应对措施：基于生态系统服务的评估与规划

abstract: When the US imposed sweeping tariff increases in 2025, most economic forecasters predicted a sharp rise in consumer prices and significant import disruption. Instead, retail prices rose modestly and import-dependent sectors held up. This column uses data for the 50 largest US trading partners to show that foreign exporters absorbed roughly 40–50% of the 2025 US tariff increases through lower export prices – much more than earlier studies suggested. The absorption was highly unequal: dominant suppliers bore the bulk, while smaller ones passed the tariff on almost fully. The aggregate result vindicates optimal tariff theory. It does not mean the tariffs made America better off.
abstract_zh: 当美国于2025年实施大规模关税上调时，多数经济预测者预计消费者价格将急剧上升，进口将遭受重大干扰。然而，零售价格仅温和上涨，依赖进口的行业也保持了稳定。本文利用美国前50大贸易伙伴的数据表明，外国出口商通过降低出口价格吸收了2025年美国关税上调的约40%至50%——这一比例远高于早期研究的估计。这种吸收效应极不均衡：主导供应商承担了大部分负担，而较小的供应商则几乎将关税完全转嫁出去。总体结果印证了最优关税理论。但这并不意味着关税使美国变得更富裕。
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象为美国关税冲击及外国出口商价格吸收，数据覆盖美国前50大贸易伙伴，未明确聚焦中国，核心应用非中国背景。
title: Foreign exporters absorbed nearly half of the 2025 US tariff shock
title_zh: 外国出口商吸收了2025年美国关税冲击的近一半

abstract: Sharp increases in interest rates can reduce the market value of banks’ securities holdings and threaten financial stability. Using euro area data for 2022-2023, this column shows that such losses can also affect monetary policy transmission through a bank collateral channel: banks with larger losses on collateral-eligible securities obtained less interbank funding and cut lending to firms. This effect was only partially offset for domestic subsidiaries in banking groups. The results demonstrate the importance of collateral values in monetary policy transmission and also emphasise the need for further financial integration across borders.
abstract_zh: 利率急剧上升可能降低银行证券持有的市场价值，并威胁金融稳定。利用2022-2023年欧元区数据，本专栏显示，此类损失还可能通过银行抵押品渠道影响货币政策传导：在符合抵押品条件的证券上损失较大的银行，获得的银行间融资减少，并削减了对企业的贷款。这一效应对于银行集团内的国内子公司仅得到部分抵消。研究结果凸显了抵押品价值在货币政策传导中的重要性，并强调了进一步跨境金融整合的必要性。
authors: Mariassunta Giannetti, Martina Jasova, Caterina Mendicino, Dominik Supera
title: The bank collateral channel of monetary policy: Evidence from securities losses
title_zh: 货币政策银行抵押品渠道：来自证券损失的证据
